name: lyra-browser
description: A persistent, logged-in Chromium that Claude drives and you can watch and take over. Navigation, form sending, uploads, downloads and publishing each ask you first through a dialog; a guard layer enforces the answer against every request, whatever caused it.

approval.title: Approval
approval.description: elicit asks you through a dialog before navigating to a site, sending a form, uploading, downloading or publishing. autonomous approves navigation to any site and declared form sends, uploads and downloads without asking; publishing is still refused, denied sites still win, and every approval is audited as consent_channel=autonomous.

follow_bypass.title: Follow bypass mode
follow_bypass.description: When Claude Code runs in bypassPermissions mode (--dangerously-skip-permissions), lyra stops asking too: navigation, form sends, uploads, downloads and publishing go ahead without a dialog, audited as consent_channel=bypass. Denied sites, file: and data: URLs and a takeover still win. The mode reaches lyra through the plugin's own hook, never from the model.

trusted_origins.title: Trusted sites
trusted_origins.description: Sites you are not asked about before navigating: https://host, bare host, or *.example.com, separated by commas. Never covers sending a form, uploading, downloading or publishing.

trusted_send_origins.title: Send-trusted sites
trusted_send_origins.description: Sites where sending a form and uploading are also pre-approved, for acceptance runs against your own product. Separate list: a trusted site is not send-trusted by being trusted.

denied_origins.title: Denied sites
denied_origins.description: Sites refused whatever else says yes. Same forms as trusted sites.

consent_timeout.title: Consent timeout (seconds)
consent_timeout.description: How long a permission dialog waits for your answer before the action counts as denied.

guard.title: Navigation guard backend
guard.description: route judges the first request of a navigation through Playwright; cdp judges every redirect hop from a second DevTools connection over a loopback debugging port. Ignored when the driver is native, which always runs the cdp guard.

headless.title: Headless
headless.description: Run without a visible window. Leave unset for a window wherever one can open; with no window, highlight, ask-the-user and takeover answer unattended.
